assumptions.text: An estimate of what the same usage would cost at the providers' public API list prices. It is not what was billed, nor money saved.
Standard list prices: no batch, volume or negotiated discount.
Global inference: no data-residency or regional multiplier.
The runners' telemetry does not report server-side tool use (web search), so its per-use charges are not included.
A failed request is counted but not priced: it reports no tokens.
Codex's input count includes its cached and (inferred) cache-write input; uncached input is what remains.
A request that reports no speed or service tier is priced at the standard tier.
